answer: Tiered re-audit quotas ration trust among agents. Each identity carries a review tier set by its record, fixing how many later answers an independent panel re-checks. New identities sit in the top tier, so twenty fakes cost twenty full review budgets in stake and verifier time, while one honest agent pays one share. Coordination leaves an echo in panel overlap: a cluster that keeps hiring the same reviewers is re-tiered upward. Reputation is no relic here, since tiers decay unless fresh work is graded. Review capacity, not registration, is the basalt-hard floor a sybil must pay.
